name: Guest Wi-Fi
description: Your guest network name and password, large and legible, next to a QR code that joins the network in one scan — with the special characters in names and passwords escaped correctly, so the code actually connects. Made for hotels, cafés, clinics and offices; works as a full screen, a portrait poster or a thin strip. Nothing is fetched: the code is drawn on the screen.
author: ScreenTinker

params.name: ssid
params.label: Network name (SSID)
params.help: Exactly as your devices show it, including capitals and spaces.

params.name: password
params.label: Password
params.help: Shown on screen on purpose — this is a guest network. Type it as is: characters like ; : , " and \ are escaped in the QR code for you.

params.name: hidden
params.label: The network is hidden
params.help: Turn on only if the network does not broadcast its name.

params.name: show_password
params.label: Show the password as text
params.help: Turn off to show only the QR code; the code still contains the password.

params.name: headline
params.label: Headline
params.default: Stay connected while you're with us

params.name: hint
params.label: Hint under the code
params.default: Point your camera here to join

params.name: hidden_text
params.label: Text when the password is not shown

params.name: footer
params.label: Footer
params.default: Need a hand? Ask anyone at the front desk — we're happy to help.

params.name: logo
params.label: Logo
params.help: A PNG or SVG with a transparent background. Leave empty for no logo.
